resources.string: Your latest entries could not be saved because the draft changed elsewhere. Close without those latest entries? The changed draft will be kept.
The operation finished on this device, but its draft changed elsewhere. Close this editor and keep the changed draft? Your calendar service still handles delivery to guests.
The original request may already have been applied, and its draft changed elsewhere. Close this editor and keep the changed draft? Do not submit another copy.
Cancel this meeting for everyone? Your unsaved field and guest changes will not be applied. Your calendar service handles cancellation notices.
Discard these entries? An uncertain saved request must be safely retired first. Discarding a draft does not cancel the meeting.
Calendar access is required to show this meeting.
Calendar access is required. Granting access does not submit this request.
This meeting or its permissions changed. Your entries remain here. Reopen its details before starting another draft.
Check your changed entries and guest addresses. Only supported changes can be saved.
This draft changed elsewhere. This editor cannot replace it.
Your latest entries could not be confirmed as a saved draft. Keep this editor open and try saving the draft.
This saved draft needs review and cannot be submitted here.
This original request is retained. Check its result before taking another action.
The original request can be retried after an explicit action.
This original request has been retired and cannot be submitted.
This request may already have been applied. Check its result before discarding it.
The original request could not be confirmed as retired. Keep this draft.
The result is uncertain. Check the original request; do not submit another copy.
Your calendar service handles updates and cancellation notices. Daylight cannot confirm delivery to guests.
